prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing / identity-preserve. Create a single seamless 16:9 STILL-FRAME character replacement mockup for an existing layered cut-paper music video. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an exact frame from the video. Input image 2 is ONLY THE CHARACTER IDENTITY / FACE / HAIR / PAPER-MATERIAL REFERENCE: a six-portrait turnaround sheet. Do NOT put the sheet, grid, labels, frames or reference background into the output. Change ONLY the central protagonist(s) of image 1. Preserve the target frame's background design, paper mountain or petal silhouettes, colors, sun, foreground elements, exact camera framing, character foot placements and scale, and the bottom Chinese lyric strip and its EXACT existing text. Do not regenerate/rearrange the scenery or enlarge the heads to portrait proportions. The result must remain a widescreen film frame. Replace the entire old simple geometric protagonist with a beautifully designed full-body version of the same person shown in reference sheet image 2, with her consistent soft oval face, warm brown almond eyes, gentle mouth, natural delicate nose, layered dark chestnut collarbone bob hair and small gold/pearl earrings. Woman wears ivory blouse, dusty-rose midi skirt, simple dark low shoes. Her face is front or gentle three-quarter turned toward the viewer so BOTH eyes are visible, no flat one-eyed profile. Preserve the reference woman's recognizable face and hair while simplifying only the tiniest strand detail at this distant view. Body proportions graceful young adult, about 5.5–6 heads tall, anatomically sensible hands, both feet on ground. All visible skin and clothing must be visibly layered matte cut paper with curved edges and fine subtle fibre texture, NO thick black outlines. Match the environment's muted palette, warmth/coolness, lighting direction, soft contact shadows, and atmospheric contrast so the character feels inside the paper set, not a large photographic sticker. Do not use a realistic human photo, giant head or bust floating over the frame. Avoid crude geometric nose, dot eyes, single-eye front view, doll-like eyes, oversized eyelashes, plain circular cap hair, extra limbs, disconnected neck and hands, duplicate protagonists, text errors, watermarks. This is ONLY a static concept composite; do not create a video, collage, storyboard or before/after panel. Scene-specific: the woman is alone standing on the gold paper path beneath the large sunrise, at the same lower-center location and approximately the same total character height as in target. Keep the path and all six paper mountain layers EXACTLY unchanged. She holds the small gold star at her outstretched right hand and turns her head gently 25 degrees toward the viewer (two eyes visible), with a hopeful subtle smile. Preserve the lyric “还有能够装下星空的期待” exactly.
